sourceEditions.processAuthority: ISO New England regional system planning
sourceEditions.geographicScope: Regional system planning list across Connecticut, Massachusetts, Maine, New Hampshire, Rhode Island and Vermont; partial public inventory, not all local transmission work.
sourceEditions.inventoryScope: Individual RSP listed work items with latest status Planned, Under Construction or Proposed. In-service and cancelled rows excluded. Duplicate formatted/topical sheets are not additional inventory; asset-condition list is outside this source.
limitations: No native coordinates; every record remains unlocated and outside proximity matching.
Projected in-service dates have month precision; stored Excel days do not supply exact milestone days.
Proposed is retained with unknown normalized lifecycle; elapsed dates do not establish completion.
Owner identities are source-scoped and do not establish cross-source corporate equivalence.
Native Project IDs identify listed work items; major project names do not establish deduplication.
Public source is attributed for private project analysis; no dataset-specific open reuse license identified.
